title: Codophon Configuration
description: Configuration file for Codophon. Supports JSON and JSONC (JSON with Comments).

$schema.description: Path to the JSON schema for editor autocompletion.

agentBackend.description: Which agent CLI powers review assistance and walkthroughs. 'codex' uses the OpenAI Codex CLI; 'claude' uses the Claude Code CLI; 'opencode' uses the OpenCode CLI.

checkForUpdates.description: Check GitHub Releases once a day for a newer Codophon version, download it in the background, and offer to restart into it. Set to false if updates are centrally managed.

codeFontFamily.description: CSS font family name used for diff and code rendering. Leave empty to use Codophon's bundled mono stack.

codeFontSize.description: Font size in pixels used for diff and code rendering.

copyCommentsOnClose.description: Copy pending review comments to clipboard when closing a window.

diffStyle.description: Diff layout style. 'split' shows deleted and added lines side by side; 'unified' shows them in one column.

editorCommand.description: Command used to open files from Codophon. Use {file} as the file path placeholder, {line} as the optional line number, and {repo} as the repository root placeholder, for example "subl \"{repo}\" \"{file}\"", or leave empty to use Codophon's default editor lookup.

expandUnchanged.description: Show full files in diffs instead of collapsing unchanged lines between hunks.

lastRepositoryPath.description: The last repository opened by Codophon when no path was explicitly provided.

renderMarkdownAs.description: How Markdown files open in reviews. 'preview' shows the rendered document; 'source' shows the text diff.

reviewCommentsPrefix.description: Markdown prefix prepended to copied review comments. Set to an empty string to omit the heading entirely.

sidebarPosition.description: Side of the desktop window where the file sidebar appears.

reviewTheme.description: Diff colors, independent of light/dark appearance. Both presets keep code backgrounds neutral and emphasize changed words. 'neutral' uses green/red markers; 'blue-amber' uses blue/amber markers.

showOutdated.description: Show review comments anchored to outdated diff lines. Hidden by default, matching GitHub's review UI.

showWhitespace.description: Show whitespace-only changes in diffs and file line counts.

theme.description: Application color theme. 'system' follows OS preference.

agentPrompts.description: Replacements for Codophon's default writing guidance. Omit a key to use its default. Output schemas and review evidence rules are unchanged.

walkthrough.description: Additional instructions appended to generated walkthrough prompts. Use this to request a language, tone, or level of detail while Codophon keeps its walkthrough guide, hunk ids, review-order constraints, and schema.

wordWrap.description: Wrap long diff lines instead of using horizontal scrolling.

model.description: The Claude Code model alias ('opus', 'sonnet', or 'haiku') to use for review assistance and walkthroughs when agentBackend is 'claude'. The Claude Code CLI resolves each alias to its latest model.
The OpenAI model to use for review assistance and walkthroughs.

reasoningEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort for review assistance and walkthroughs. Supported values depend on the selected model and installed Codex CLI. Leave empty to preserve Codophon's existing defaults for its predefined models and inherit Codex settings for other models.

model.description: The OpenCode model to use for review assistance, walkthroughs, and the managed /codophon command when agentBackend is 'opencode'. Use 'opencode-default' to preserve OpenCode's configured default, or a provider-qualified model id such as 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6'.

keymap.description: Keyboard shortcut overrides for in-app actions. Use 'Mod' for Cmd on macOS and Ctrl on other platforms.

commandBar.description: Open the command palette. Accepts a single combo or a list of aliases.

editFile.description: Start editing the currently highlighted working-tree file.

doneEditing.description: Save and finish editing the focused or highlighted file.

fileFilter.description: Focus the file filter search input in the sidebar.

nextHunk.description: Jump to the next hunk or review comment. Accepts a single combo or a list of aliases.

prevHunk.description: Jump to the previous hunk or review comment. Accepts a single combo or a list of aliases.

nextSearchMatch.description: Navigate to the next search match.

openFile.description: Open the currently selected file in the configured editor.

prevSearchMatch.description: Navigate to the previous search match.

shortcutsHelp.description: Hold to show the keyboard shortcut overlay.

submitComment.description: Add the review comment being written, submitting it remotely when the review source supports it.

askAgent.description: Ask the configured agent about the review comment being written.

toggleSidebar.description: Toggle the sidebar between expanded and collapsed states.

toggleWordWrap.description: Toggle word wrap for long diff lines.
